subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: Should maintainers accept a proof override for this xAI/Grok stale encrypted_content retry fix, given the exact code-less provider-side stale-key event is not client-inducible on demand?
rationale: ClawSweeper's normal external-PR gate requires after-fix real behavior proof, but the code change is a narrow matcher over an already-existing retry path and the contributor provided pre-fix production logs plus positive/negative source coverage.

options.title: Accept Proof Override
options.body: Treat the non-inducible xAI rotation event as enough reason to accept pre-fix logs plus focused predicate coverage, then merge only after normal exact-head CI and mergeability checks pass.

options.title: Wait For Organic Capture
options.body: Keep the PR open until the contributor can attach redacted after-fix gateway logs from a real future xAI stale-key event.

options.title: Pause The Fix
options.body: Leave the Grok outage risk unresolved until maintainers decide that source-level evidence is not enough for this provider behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept Proof Override
recommendation.body: Treat the non-inducible xAI rotation event as enough reason to accept pre-fix logs plus focused predicate coverage, then merge only after normal exact-head CI and mergeability checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The proof decision is maintainer-policy judgment, and steipete has recent adjacent history on OpenAI Responses reasoning behavior in this file.
